🚀 GitRoot 0.5.0 is out!

GitRoot the lightweight, self-hosted git forge, without database but a lot of plugins.

True to its motto "Move slowly, and take care of things" this release focuses on deep craftsmanship rather than the AI race.

Key highlights:


 - 📦 Breaking PURL: Migrated plugin URLs to the ECMA-427 standard.
 - 🛡️ Anonymous Anti-Spam: New branch limits to prevent spam/abuse without registration.
 - ⚡ Zig SDK: Plugin development now supports Zig alongside Go, Rust, and AssemblyScript.
 - 🛠️ Plugin Power-Ups: HTTP requests, cron-based job scheduling, and flexible callFunc configs.
 - 📂 SFTP Support: Easily manage your repo's web files using your existing SSH keys.


Check out the official blog post for all the details: https://gitroot.dev/blog/version-0.5.0.html

#FOSS #SelfHosted #Forge #OpenSource #ZigLang #Wasm
